contract_traces.trace: Texture2d::write, Texture3d::write, Texture2d::create_from_image, TextureCube::create_from_images and set_side_image all build canonical tight transfer layout and call its write56-81, which observes immediate Queue.write_texture without adding completion wait/256alignment/exactsource-length requirement. Texture2d::read_image obtains logical Vec<u8> then reads exact size_of<f32> chunks with from_ne_bytes131-146, preserving native endian and old clamp/round/greyscale/alpha; no f32 alignment demand onbyteVec. Canonical transfer sizes for R32/RGBA32 prove completewordlength. Image::packed_for and cube set_side_image conversion policies remain distinct exactly; no gamma/remainder/format normalization.

Image::packed_for fallback now derives expectedbytes through same checked transfer owner rather than u32 width*height*pixel. It keeps permissive pixel_size4 policy and rawImage schema. Cube floatconversion reserves actual raw byte count as safe upper bound for fourfloat outputs per completefourbyte input group, retaining TryReserveError; same chunks/remainders/channelmath/transfer/alpha produce same successful bytes. No extra domain count wrapper, dimension brand or source-length restriction.

Texture owns checked row/volume recipes, Buffer owns map lifecycle and hostcopy, Context owns immediate/native observation and submission, Image owns conversion, compute owns grouped Readback. Narrow inGPU visibility reuses actual current buffer types; owning private TransferResult and existing ReadResult used, distinct generic/native/BufferRead errors explicit. ReadKind is diagnostic native role enum, fixedface/index labels remain nativeABI. No duplicate owner, raw policy String, unused abstraction/import, cfg-only privateinterface, compatibility API, new unsafe/production unwrap/expect/suppression/testhelper discovered. Modules order imports/reexports->mods->constaliases->structs->enum->impl follows crates90-94.
